title: OOM 跳批最大连续次数

standard.summary: OOM 跳批（oom_skip_batch_enabled）的安全阀：连续多少个 batch 因显存不足被跳过后，停止训练而不是无限空转。默认 3。
standard.effect: 单次 OOM 时清缓存、跳过该 batch 继续；连续 OOM 计数达到本值时判定为系统性显存不足，训练终止并报错，避免整个 epoch 被静默跳空。
standard.whenToUse: 分辨率分桶差异大、偶发大 bucket 撑爆显存的场景保持默认即可；想更快失败便于排查时调小到 1~2。
standard.avoidWhen: oom_skip_batch_enabled 关闭时无效；把该值调大并不能解决显存不足，只是推迟报错，根因应通过降低 batch/分辨率或开启显存优化解决。

standard_en.summary: The safety valve on OOM batch skipping (oom_skip_batch_enabled): how many consecutive batches may be skipped for lack of VRAM before training stops rather than spinning forever. Default 3.
standard_en.effect: A single OOM clears the cache, skips that batch and carries on; when the consecutive OOM count reaches this value the shortage is judged systemic, and training stops with an error rather than letting a whole epoch be silently skipped.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default is fine when resolution buckets vary a lot and a large bucket occasionally blows out VRAM; lower it to 1~2 when you want it to fail faster for diagnosis.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It has no effect while oom_skip_batch_enabled is off; raising it does not solve a VRAM shortage, it only delays the error -- fix the root cause by lowering the batch or resolution, or by turning on VRAM optimisations.

advanced.principle: 偶发 OOM（个别超大样本）与系统性 OOM（配置整体超预算）需要不同处置：前者跳过即可，后者继续跳只会产出没有训练量的假进度。连续计数器区分两者——任何一次成功 step 都会重置计数。
advanced.intervention: training_loop_epoch_mixin.py 的 batch 循环：捕获 CUDA OOM 后 oom_skip_enabled 决定是否跳过，oom_max_consecutive（本键）决定连续失败上限，超限抛出终止。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练对偶发显存尖峰更有韧性，同时保证真正配置错误时快速失败。
advanced.tradeoffs: 被跳过的 batch 本轮不参与学习，跳批率高时有效数据量下降；日志中应关注跳批告警而非只看训练是否在跑。

advanced_en.principle: Sporadic OOMs (an occasional oversized sample) and systematic OOMs (the config is over budget overall) need different handling: the former just gets skipped, while continuing to skip the latter only produces fake progress with no training. A consecutive-failure counter distinguishes the two — any successful step resets the count.
advanced_en.intervention: The batch loop in training_loop_epoch_mixin.py: after catching a CUDA OOM, oom_skip_enabled decides whether to skip, and oom_max_consecutive (this key) sets the consecutive-failure cap, after which it raises and terminates.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Training becomes more resilient to sporadic VRAM spikes while failing fast on genuine config errors.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Skipped batches do not participate in learning that round; a high skip rate lowers the effective data volume. Watch skip-rate warnings in the logs rather than only whether training is still running.
